subject: Request: BYOK onboarding artifacts + wrap/unwrap test vectors

messages:
From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@greenslopehealth.com>

Cc: GreenSlope Security <security@greenslopehealth.com>
Date: 2028-04-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: BYOK onboarding artifacts and wrap/unwrap test vectors

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our SIG submission and internal risk scoping we need the following artifacts to validate BYOK & HSM controls for our redacted pilot:

- A copy of your BYOK onboarding checklist (redacted for internal IP)
- Example wrap/unwrap test vectors (sample keys only, not customer secrets) so our team can validate integration logic
- The most recent HSM attestation (certificate + signing chain)
- Current KMS key rotation schedule and policies (how often, automated vs manual)

We are hoping to ship the SIG in the next 10 business days — can you confirm what you can provide and approximate delivery ETA? If any documents need an NDA or alternate transmission channel (FedRAMP S3 share / signed attestation), let us know.

Appreciate it —
Alice Monroe
Security Engineering Manager
GreenSlope Health

Ben / Laura — forwarding request from GreenSlope. They want BYOK onboarding artifacts and sample wrap/unwrap vectors to finish a SIG submission. They specifically called out HSM attestation and rotation schedule.

Can we assemble a redacted packet that includes:
- A sanitized BYOK onboarding checklist (remove any internal runbooks and IP)
- Synthetic wrap/unwrap vectors (test key IDs and sample ciphertexts)
- HSM attestation cert (latest) and explanation of signing chain
- KMS rotation cadence document (human-readable + CSV schedule)

I’ll aim to reply to GreenSlope with a secure Drive link and DocuSign route once we have the packet. Target ETA: EOD 2028-04-18 if that fits with your teams.

Thanks —
Stephanie
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Stephanie / Laura —

We can produce everything requested. Plan:

1) BYOK_onboarding_checklist (redacted) — remove internal ticket links and specific infra hostnames; add a short appendix that maps public steps to customer actions. (will attach PDF)

I’ll produce the artifacts, mark anything that needs legal/signature routing, and upload to the secure Drive folder Stephanie suggested. ETA: draft artifacts by 2028-04-17 EOD; final packet and DocuSign routing 2028-04-18.

Ben

Subject: Deliverable: BYOK packet + wrap/unwrap test vectors (secure link)

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the patience. We’ve assembled a redacted BYOK packet and the requested synthetic wrap/unwrap vectors. The packet includes:

- redacted_BYOK_onboarding_checklist.pdf (sanitized onboarding steps and customer responsibilities)
- wrap_unwrap_test_vectors.txt (synthetic key IDs + sample ciphertexts, verification instructions)
- hsm_attestation_cert.pem (latest HSM attestation, public cert chain attached)
- kms_rotation_schedule.csv (abstracted rotation cadence and emergency rotation procedure)
- byok-attestation-signature_request.docx (one-paragraph attestation for signature)

Secure download: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBz-Redwood-BYOK-GS-2028 (Link shared with GreenSlope security group only)
DocuSign attestation: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/abcd-1234-byok-attestation

A few clarifications for your SIG reviewers:
- We do not persist customer unencrypted BYOK material in Redwood systems; only wrapped key material (key-encryption-keys) is stored and is protected by HSMs.
- Key rotation cadence: ephemeral keys = monthly; provider-managed KEKs = quarterly; emergency rotation is documented in the attached CSV and will be executed via our emergency runbook (we will provide logs on request under NDA).
- Wrap/unwrap test vectors are synthetic and intended for integration testing only — they do not correspond to production customer keys.

If you need anything redacted further or prefer a different transfer mechanism (SFTP/FedRAMP share), tell us and we’ll accommodate.

Best —
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
